decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans PR 37957/04 Rev C submitted  14 March 2011 and PR 37957/05 submitted 17 January 2011 and plans 37957/03 and Supporting Statement submitted 26 October 2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The area shown for storage of refuse on the plans hereby approved shall be provided before the development is first occupied, shall be kept permanently available for this purpose and shall be kept accessible to the occupiers of both the ground and first floors. It shall be permanently screened by a 2meter high close boarded boundary fence adjoining the footway, which shall be kept permanently intact. No refuse generated by the ground floor unit shall be stored other than in storage bins with separate bins provided for refuse and recyclable materials in the designated storage area and the lids of the bins shall be kept permanently shut. The commercial refuse shall be removed from site not less than once a week.
description: Erection of single storey side and rear extensions to the existing retail unit, change of use of first floor to a self contained residential unit incorporating the erection of a rear roof extension
